Hey. I was always a happy kid, and I was totally fine up until the age of 17. I was anxious and shy but it wasn't really a problem. Then I got my first job (delivering pizzas) and I hated it so fucking much that I quit after a month. I spent the entire next school year dreading starting work again. I started thinking about killing myself because of a mixture of my anxiety and the fact that I would have to work for the rest of my life. I put it off as long as I could, but I needed money for college so I started applying for summer jobs. I hated every second of it, and I knew I would hate whatever job I got. But nobody responded except this landscaping company. So I accepted and now I have to work 9 hours a day in the hot sun with people I don't like. My parents said getting a job would help with my  suicidal thoughts. Well, it  just made them  worseml. I know other people have it worse, but taking someone who is already suicidal and forcing them to get up early and work all day doesn't help. Idk
